summary: Join our Dodd-Frank and Volcker Rule compliance training course to gain critical insights and strategies for effective regulatory adherence in your organization
lede: Financial trading compliance training helps front-office, risk, compliance, legal and audit professionals assess trading and investment activities against relevant rules. It develops skills in distinguishing proprietary trading from permitted market-making, underwriting and hedging; evaluating fund structures and ownership restrictions; and designing governance, controls, metrics, reporting and review processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work within or around Dodd-Frank and Volcker Rule obligations, providing the knowledge and tools necessary to navigate complex regulatory landscapes.
modules: Regulatory Landscape and Purpose of Dodd-Frank
Volcker Rule Essentials and Core Definitions
Identifying Proprietary Trading and Permitted Activities
Designing a Dodd-Frank and Volcker Compliance Framework
Controls, Metrics, and Reporting in Practice
Supervisory Reviews, Audits, and Enforcement Trends
Integrating Dodd-Frank and Volcker Compliance with Risk Management
Implementation Roadmaps, Change Management, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial markets and basic regulatory compliance principles. Experience in trading, risk management, or compliance roles is recommended.
